pages.text: Pattern scrolls are the mod's knowledge: each teaches exactly one symbol. They cannot be crafted — adventurers before you left them in $(thing)dungeons$(), $(thing)mineshafts$(), $(thing)desert and jungle temples$(), $(thing)strongholds$(), $(thing)woodland mansions$() and $(thing)buried treasure$().
A scroll is consumed when its pattern is successfully engraved, so spend them with care. Its tooltip names the pattern it teaches.
